questions.prompt: What is Marcus's primary grievance regarding the store's promotion?
options: He is unable to access his Gold Member status on the mobile app.
The store's scanner is failing to read his digital barcode properly.
He feels the marketing materials were intentionally misleading.
He wants to return three sweaters and a kitchen mixer.

questions.prompt: What does Sloane determine to be the root cause of the system error?
options: The customer's phone screen brightness was too low for the laser.
The loyalty account was not properly logged into the store app.
Certain product categories are ineligible for the price reduction.
The digital flyer was missing the tiny gray text at the bottom.

questions.prompt: How does Sloane's role shift throughout the interaction?
options: From a technical troubleshooter to an interpreter of restrictive clauses.
From a loyal "Gold Member" advocate to a strict enforcer of store rules.
From a skeptic of the app's functionality to a critic of the manufacturer.
From a retail assistant to a specialist in high-end kitchen electronics.

questions.prompt: What does Sloane imply about the store's pricing software?
options: It prioritizes the company's financial sustainability over individual discounts.
It allows for a manager override when a clearance tag is detected.
It is programmed to reward Gold Members with a technical loop.
It offers a forty percent markdown on all winter close-out items.

questions.prompt: How does Marcus feel about the current cost of the sweaters?
options: He is frustrated that the winter close-out sale is only five dollars off.
He believes the current promotion is a headache compared to full price.
He perceives the current valuation as counterproductive to his savings goal.
He thinks the apparel is ineligible because it didn't meet the minimum spend.

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes Sloane's professional stance?
options: She is strictly bound by the itemized list on her screen.
She acknowledges the customer's perspective despite the rigid protocols.
She intends to rewrite the policy regarding stacking rewards.
She blames the system for the misleading headlines of the coupons.

questions.prompt: What does Marcus propose as a potential compromise?
options: Forfeiting the markdown on the kitchen appliance.
Converting the sweaters into a single item.
Utilizing the voucher at a later date.
Acquiring the garments at their initial valuation.

questions.prompt: Why was the manager willing to provide an alternative solution?
options: The digital interface provided ambiguous data.
The supervisor witnessed the entire interaction.
The manufacturer lifted the restriction on the mixer.
The store wanted to promote their new mobile app.
